title: SB1 sidebar rows, resources variant (vs Monitor's sidebar)

spec.exclude_note: The sparklines are DT1's Sparkline (the data family), not a rows part.
spec.freeze_note: Monitor's values are live; the capture stops its timers and pins them to the sample values the GTK surface shows.
spec.accent_note: The Studio tints its light mode with the wallpaper's hue (168); the kit's tokens are the default accent (258), so the spec is pinned to it.

states.name: resources
states.about: Monitor's resources, CPU chosen (v70's opening state)

spec.eval: for (let i = 1; i < 100000; i++) { clearInterval(i); clearTimeout(i); } [['cpu','54%'],['mem','7.9 of 16 GB'],['disk','182.5 MB/s'],['net','↓ 5.8 MB/s'],['en','74% · 4 h left']].forEach(([k,v]) => { const e = document.querySelector(`[data-mnsv="${k}"]`); if (e) e.textContent = v; })

pairs_note: No structure pair: the surface fills its window, so the window's own frame paint would be read as the sidebar's.
